zh-CN.win10-eos-infobar-body: Microsoft 已不再为 Windows 10 提供支持。请备份您的信息，为在 Windows 11 上使用 Firefox 做好准备。

userFacingDescription: A persistent infobar to inform Windows 10 users about the upcoming End of Support and guide them in safely transitioning their Firefox data.
